text:
violet: Noticed tenants reporting sudden drop in 'cache savings' after variant swap. Marquee customer saw -18%.
marco: Yep. Our credits ledger keys by model_sku. When a variant creates a new sku the previous credits look missing.
devin: Proposal: emit a lightweight "variant_transfer" event at rollout with rollout_id, from_sku, to_sku, tokens_moved, ts so econ can surface transfers rather than letting numbers disappear.
ux-lex: UI suggestion: default summary hides transfer rows but shows a small "Transfers" pill users can expand. Add a "Why did my savings change?" link that opens a timeline modal.
marco: Backend plan: econ exporter supports include_transfers flag, transfer rows have transfer=true and billable=false so billing exports don't double-charge. We'll precompute a daily transfer lookup to avoid streaming joins.
violet: Monitoring: add an alert if post-rollout tenant delta < -10% within 2h and no transfer event exists; route to #econ-ops.
alerts-bot: infra-bot: variant_transfer schema PR merged to #pull-requests (link). CI green. :rocket:
marco: I'll add transfer emission + daily map (est 1.5d). ux-lex can mock the pill and tooltip.
ux-lex: Will post mock by EOD and add tooltip copy explaining "credits moved due to variant rollout".
violet: I'll update docs and ping billing about non-billable transfer rows.
